message:
fix(host): epoch gate fails closed on unknown/future epochs, caps encoder rebuilds; sender fences queued pre-flush AUs

Review conditions on 1607404 (P11).

- host_epoch_gate.hpp: an AU with no FIFO provenance (epoch 0) or an epoch the host never
  issued is never sent and never opens the gate; a valid current-epoch keyframe is accepted
  before any bound; at most 3 encoder rebuilds per 10 s, after which the gate keeps
  dropping and re-forcing the key instead of re-initialising forever. The codec no longer
  dresses an output the FIFO lost track of as this call's epoch (it reports 0).
- The emit gate only covers AUs that reach it: EncodedSendItem.inputEpoch + a fence at the
  sender's dequeue (against CaptureState::inputEpoch) drops AUs that were already queued
  when the flush landed. Scope stated in the header: the one AU whose chunks were being
  sent completes (in-flight exception; the viewer's held-resume rule covers its stamp).
- Tests: remote60_host_sender_epoch_test runs the REAL sender thread over loopback UDP --
  queued old AUs never start and the IDR is first; an in-flight AU completes and the IDR
  follows with no other old AU; the fence is the epoch, not the generation, and untagged
  items pass. host_encode_epoch_test runs the flush reproduction on all three input paths
  (BGRA buffer = the field host's path: not reproduced here; NV12 buffer and D3D11 surface:
  reproduced, 800 ms) and pins the fail-closed and rebuild-cap rules.
